title: Upstream Code Edit Invalidates Host Evidence
description: The host completes the window grid and records fresh evidence on commit A. The laptop then edits the same experiment on commit B and syncs HEAD. Relay must detect the new artifact, cascade STALE to the downstream evidence node, and refuse to serve the outdated metrics.

injected_fault.detail: After the host records grid metrics, change the default EWMA alpha and commit a new upstream revision

user_prompt: I changed the smoothing default after the host already ran the grid. Which results are still valid for the new code?
forbidden_hallucinations: citing the pre-edit MAE as valid for the new commit
reporting a STALE evidence node as fresh

ground_truth_assertions.description: The upstream commit flips exactly one downstream evidence node to STALE
No evidence node for the previous commit is still advertised as fresh
The completed task record survives the invalidation instead of being rewritten or deleted
Reading the STALE evidence log is refused at the engine boundary
